scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && node scripts/write-sw.mjs production && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:emulator: npm --prefix functions run build && node scripts/write-sw.mjs development && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build --mode development
scripts.test: vitest run && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-family-care "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-family-care "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
